news.headline: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings raises $2B to bring AI to the enterprise
news.summary: Thrive Holdings, backed by OpenAI, just closed a $2 billion funding round to scale AI tools for enterprises. The funding values the company at $12 billion and includes major checks from SoftBank, D1 Capital Partners, and Altimeter Capital.

news.headline: How a $250 million acquisition collapsed into allegations of fraud and forged signatures
news.summary: An acquisition worth $250M imploded after fraud allegations and forged signatures emerged, leaving investors still waiting for their payouts. VideoVerse co-founder Vinayak Shrivastav now faces multiple legal cases tied to the collapsed deal—a cautionary tale about due diligence in high-stakes tech M&A.

educational.title: How a Stock Split Actually Works
points: A stock split divides each share into multiple shares — e.g. 1 becomes 4
Your total investment value doesn't change, just the share count and price
Companies split shares to make each one look more affordable to new buyers
It's a cosmetic change, not a sign the company suddenly became more valuable
Reverse splits do the opposite — often a red flag, not a good one
